title: Month and year of manufacture
requirement: The package must state the month and year in which the commodity was manufactured. Only the presence of that declaration is checked here, not the form it takes.
legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) of the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
source_note: Checked 2026-08-30 by Claude Code (automated legal-source check) for raghavrrrao against the Department of Consumer Affairs (Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution) consolidated publication 'Book on Legal Metrology Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011 with all amendments', https://consumeraffairs.gov.in/public/upload/admin/cmsfiles/whatsnews/Book_on_Legal_Metrology_Packaged_Commodities_Rules,2011_with_all_amendments_whatsnews.pdf (sha256 0ef948f9c6b89f5dfb20d384861901714fd0dc54fc67b5b86c772d2c3f983a4b; server Last-Modified 2025-04-14). Clause (d) reads there, verbatim: 'The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned in the package:', with the source recording that 'the words, - "or pre-packed or imported" shall be omitted vide GSR 779(E) dated 2nd November, 2021 w.e.f. 1.4.2022 (now w.e.f 01.10.2022 vide GSR 226(E) dated 28.3.2022)'. Provisos recorded verbatim in the source: for packages containing food articles the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006) and the rules made there under shall apply; 'Provided further that nothing in this sub-clause shall apply in case of packages containing seeds which are labeled and certified under the provisions of the Seeds Act, 1966 (54 of 1966) and the rules made there under'; 'Provided also that for packages containing cosmetics products, the provisions of the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 shall apply.' Proviso (A) to rule 6(1) reads verbatim: 'no declaration as to the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed shall be required to be made on-- (i) any package containing bidi or incense sticks; (ii) any domestic liquefied petroleum gas cylinder of 14.2kg or 5kg, bottled and marketed by a public sector undertaking'. THIS RULE IS EVALUATED: the implemented check tests only that a month-and-year-of-manufacture declaration is present, not the form it takes - see the _comment keys above and rules/SOURCES.md. HUMAN COUNTER-REVIEW BY A NAMED REVIEWER IS STILL OUTSTANDING.
_comment_1: Rule 6(1)(d) LMPC 2011 - month and year of manufacture.
_comment_2: STEP 2 ACTIVATION: the exemptions written into this clause are now expressed as applicability conditions on its RuleRequirement in rules/framework/rules.json, and apps.compliance.services.applicability resolves them from the facts declared for a submission BEFORE this validator runs. A package declared as one the clause excuses is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE, not as a violation. A package where the exempting fact was never declared reaches REVIEW_REQUIRED for this clause rather than a verdict. That is what makes activation safe; the categories are no longer the only lever.
_comment_3: The exemptions now carried on the requirement: food articles (FSS Act 2006), seeds certified under the Seeds Act 1966, cosmetics (Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945), and proviso (A) for bidi, incense sticks and domestic LPG cylinders of 14.2kg or 5kg bottled by a public sector undertaking.
_comment_4: PRESENCE ONLY. Whether the date is correctly FORMATTED as a month and year is not checked - that needs a format check this repository does not have. The requirement text is written to match what is tested.
